system.description:
The refined court-fencing tradition of Eltor — every fight a performance, every wound a statement.

  • Every Move a Statement: Opening Flourish applies to your first two hits in each encounter, not just the first.
  • Court Bearing: Advantage on Persuasion and Performance checks in formal social settings, and on checks impressing nobles or attending court functions.
